title: TPX Physical Properties List, revision February 2025
facts: RT18 and DX845 typical density 833 kg/m3; 23 C injection-specimen tensile modulus 1900 MPa.
DX845 lists T-die casting as recommended; RT18 as applicable.
limits: Not finished thin-film properties or measured 50 C stiffness. No lot, price or supply confirmation.

title: Opulent product grades, Mitsui Chemicals ICT Materia
facts: X-88B and X-88BMT4: 50 um single-layer film, gloss versus both-side emboss; softening indicator 52 C.
This softening indicator is the temperature at which tensile modulus is 300 MPa.
CR2031MT4: 120 um multilayer film; indicator 46 C.
limits: Do not assign 300 MPa at 50 C. Multilayer composition is not disclosed here. No UHMWPE sliding test or outdoor durability proof.

title: TPX film examples, Mitsui Chemicals
facts: RT18 100 um film: tensile modulus MD/TD 1.1/1.1 GPa; Elmendorf tear 33/195 N/cm.
Film examples list surface tension 24 mN/m.
limits: Film-table temperature is unspecified. Equal elastic modulus does not prove equal tear resistance. Releasability is not ski friction.
Displayed friction/abrasion discussion under Other PFAS Alternatives concerns MIPELON/LUBMER, not a TPX friction measurement.

title: JP7088689B2, Table 1 and ring-test method
facts: A1 comparative example: friction 0.51, wear 225 mg. Example 1 blend: 0.35, 35 mg.
S45C, 0.75 MPa, 30 m/min, 0.9 km, 23 C ambient; frictional heating was measured.
limits: A1 is the patent's synthesized resin, not identified as RT18, DX845 or Opulent.
Not a 50 C UHMWPE-pair coefficient. Table temperature label versus temperature-rise wording is ambiguous; not used as an absolute contact temperature.
Other comparison columns have composition/total inconsistencies; not corrected or used for recipe calculations.
Published composition is prior technical work; no novelty or freedom-to-operate opinion provided.

title: Pearce and Vancso, Frictional anisotropy and sectorization in poly(4-methyl-1-pentene) lamellar crystals studied by lateral force microscopy
inspection: Author-institution repository abstract retrieved via search; direct page/full article unavailable in this session
facts: Lateral-force microscopy on solution-grown lamellar crystals reports friction-direction dependence within fold domains.
limits: No macroscopic ski friction number extracted. Polymer lamellae are not ice's crystal structure, warm-spray snowfall or a completed branched skiing material.

title: Opulent product overview, Mitsui Chemicals America
facts: Manufacturer says Opulent contains no plasticizer or silicone.
limits: Does not establish all additives, wear-particle safety, exposure limits, fluorine-free status of every finished grade, or environmental acceptability.
